review_candidates.title: Director of Information Technology
review_candidates.description: Si želite prevzeti pomembno strateško vodstveno vlogo na področju IT v uspešnem mednarodnem podjetju, ki vstopa v novo fazo tehnološkega razvoja? Vas privlači priložnost, da skupaj z izkušeno ekipo in na trdnih temeljih obstoječega IT-okolja uresničite jasno začrtano modernizacijo ključnih poslovnih sistemov, uvedete sodobne tehnologije ter oblikujete rešitve, ki bodo podpirale prihodnji razvoj enega vodilnih podjetij v farmacevtskem sektorju? Ponujamo zanimiv vodstveni in tehnološki izziv. Za našega naročnika, uspešno mednarodno podjetje z dolgoletno tradicijo in vodilno vlogo na slovenskem farmacevtskem trgu, iščemo strateško usmerjenega managerja, ki bo prevzel odgovornost za nadaljnji razvoj IT področja. Vloga ima v podjetju pomemben strateški položaj. Novi direktor bo skrbel za zanesljivo delovanje poslovno kritičnih sistemov ter hkrati vodil njihovo premišljeno in postopno modernizacijo. Med ključnimi razvojnimi projekti bodo prenova ERP- in CRM-okolja, nadaljnja krepitev informacijske varnosti ter uvajanje sodobnih tehnologij, vključno s smiselnimi možnostmi uporabe umetne inteligence. To je priložnost za izkušenega vodjo, ki dobro razume tehnologijo, zna razvijati ljudi in voditi kompleksne projekte ter želi s svojimi odločitvami neposredno vplivati na nadaljnji razvoj uspešnega podjetja. Glavne naloge: oblikovanje in uresničevanje dolgoročne IT-strategije v skladu s poslovnimi cilji podjetja; vodenje, razvoj in povezovanje strokovne IT-ekipe nadaljnji razvoj organizacije IT-področja ter optimizacija odgovornosti, procesov in sodelovanja med posameznimi enotami zagotavljanje stabilnega, varnega in zanesljivega delovanja poslovno kritičnih informacijskih sistemov načrtovanje in vodenje postopne modernizacije obstoječega tehnološkega okolja vodenje prenove ERP- in CRM-sistemov ter drugih strateških IT-projektov nadaljnja krepitev informacijske varnosti in odpornosti IT-okolja spremljanje razvoja sodobnih tehnologij ter presoja njihove poslovno smiselne uporabe prepoznavanje možnosti za uporabo umetne inteligence, avtomatizacije, napredne analitike in sodobnih podatkovnih rešitev zagotavljanje, da IT-rešitve učinkovito podpirajo logistične, distribucijske, finančne in druge ključne poslovne procese sodelovanje z upravo, poslovnimi področji, mednarodnim okoljem, tehnološkimi partnerji in zunanjimi izvajalci upravljanje projektnih prioritet, tehnoloških partnerjev in IT-investicij. Pričakujemo: izkušnje z vodenjem IT-oddelka ali večje IT-ekipe, zaželeno v mednarodnem okolju odlično poznavanje sodobnih tehnologij, IT-arhitektur in trendov digitalne transformacije dobro razumevanje poslovnih informacijskih sistemov, infrastrukture, aplikativnega razvoja, integracij, podatkovnih rešitev in informacijske varnosti sposobnost oblikovanja dolgoročne IT-strategije in njenega prenosa v jasen ter izvedljiv razvojni načrt zaželene izkušnje z modernizacijo kompleksnejših tehnoloških okolij ali prenovo poslovno kritičnih sistemov sposobnost presojanja, katere nove tehnologije lahko podjetju prinesejo konkretno in dolgoročno poslovno vrednost sposobnosti vodenja, povezovanja, motiviranja in razvoja strokovnih ekip sposobnost povezovanja poslovnih potreb s tehnološkimi rešitvami strateško razmišljanje, odločnost, odgovornost in pragmatičen pristop dobro znanje angleškega jezika ter sposobnost uspešnega sodelovanja v mednarodnem okolju. Prednost predstavljajo: izkušnje iz logistike, distribucije, veleprodaje ali drugega okolja s kompleksno oskrbovalno verigo sodelovanje pri implementaciji ali večji prenovi informacijskega sistema poznavanje praktičnih možnosti uporabe umetne inteligence in avtomatizacije v poslovnem okolju izkušnje iz okolja, v katerem sta zanesljivost in neprekinjeno delovanje informacijskih sistemov ključna za poslovanje. review_candidates.title: Desk Side Support Field Engineer
review_candidates.description: Overview NSC Global is looking for Level 1 Field Service Technicians to deliver on site technical support for customer systems. The role covers on site hardware troubleshooting, repair and replacement, diagnostics, service call updates, parts handling and customer communication, in line with agreed service levels and established field service procedures. Technicians attend customer locations, validate reported faults, complete the intervention and provide accurate updates throughout. The position requires sound technical troubleshooting ability, professional communication, close adherence to process and the ability to work to deadlines driven by service level agreements. Responsibilities Attend customer sites within agreed service windows and complete each intervention to the required standard. Perform on site troubleshooting, diagnostics, hardware repair and component replacement across desktops, laptops and related client hardware. Validate warranty status, asset identification and diagnostic findings before completing any repair. Apply approved diagnostic tools and methods, including built in diagnostics, LED fault codes and structured logical troubleshooting. Confirm receipt of service calls, manage estimated arrival updates and maintain accurate records in the required systems, with arrival updates within 15 minutes and closure within 30 minutes of service completion. Generate electronic service reports through the designated field service platform and obtain customer sign off following each intervention. Reinstall BIOS, drivers and operating systems where instructed and where approved recovery media is available. Troubleshoot hardware related networking faults falling within the scope of the service call. Order additional parts through the approved process, following completion of documented troubleshooting. Collect, manage, package, label and return defective or unused parts within the required process and timescales. Keep customers informed throughout the intervention, including next steps, repeat visits and parts requirements. Escalate unusual incidents immediately, including customer dissatisfaction, damage, missing equipment, unsafe environments or any issue affecting service delivery. Comply with all electrostatic discharge, safety and documented procedural requirements, and display the required identification while on customer sites. review_candidates.title: GRC Data Scientist
review_candidates.description: Job Family Data Science & Analysis Travel Required Up to 10% Clearance Required Ability to Obtain Public Trust What You Will Do The Guidehouse Technology AI & Data team is seeking a Data Scientist to support the development of analytical and automation solution for clients across our Department of Justice (DOJ) portfolio. This high performing team works with clients to implement the full spectrum of data analytics and data science, from data querying and data wrangling, to data visualization and dashboarding, to predictive analytics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence as well as robotic process automation (RPA). Our services enable our clients to define their information strategy, enable mission critical insights and data-driven decision making, reduce cost and complexity, increase trust, and improve operational effectiveness. Turn cybersecurity and GRC data into actionable insights that support RMF workflows, continuous monitoring, vulnerability management, and authorization activities. Design and deliver analytics (descriptive, diagnostic, predictive) and ML models that improve risk visibility (e.g., predictive risk scoring, anomaly detection) and inform remediation priorities. Partner with ISSOs, system owners, and Agile delivery teams to define data requirements, curate datasets, and operationalize dashboards for mission decision-making. Operate within CI/CD and DevSecOps practices to version experiments, automate data/feature pipelines, and validate models in controlled environments. Communicate findings in plain language and produce clear visualizations and documentation that align to stakeholder needs. What You Will Need Must be able to OBTAIN and MAINTAIN a Federal or DHS "PUBLIC TRUST"; candidates must obtain approved adjudication of their PUBLIC TRUST prior to onboarding with Guidehouse. Candidates with an ACTIVE PUBLIC TRUST or SUITABILITY are preferred. Bachelor’s degree THREE (3) or more years’ experience as a Data Security Analyst or equivalent knowledge. FOUR (4) or more years’ experience in data analytics with large data sets. Experience working on data analytics, modeling, or visualization projects in a consulting or federal environment. Experience working with Python, SQL, and other modern scripting languages used in analytics. Experience working with at least one major BI/data visualization platform (Tableau, Power BI, or Qlik). Ability to support on-site and hybrid projects in the DC metro area What Would Be Nice To Have Active DOJ Suitability or Active Secret Clearance Ability to think strategically and drive innovation. Ability to transform cybersecurity/GRC datasets (e.g., vulnerability and asset posture, compliance/scoring data) into reliable features and decision-ready insights. Familiarity with Federal cybersecurity and compliance frameworks: NIST SP 800-53, NIST RMF, OSCAL, FedRAMP. Experience ingesting and analyzing signals from Tenable, Qualys, CrowdStrike, BigFix; CDM/SIEM integrations. Experience with large-scale ETL/ELT pipelines and API-first integrations; experience with micro-ETL/event-driven patterns. Hands-on analytics in SQL-based environments (Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL) and search/feature retrieval using ElasticSearch. Experience with approved enterprise AI tools (e.g., Amazon Q, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini) within responsible AI governance.
